description: Official latest MM bytes, universe, cutoff, reuse conditions and the additional Coding Procedure remain unverified.
required_followup: Coordinator must verify the official baseline and compatibility before export or approval.

description: Open-web search is not equivalent to the manual LexisNexis procedure. Weekly and date operators returned substantial unrelated date and country noise.
required_followup: Use systematic contemporary archives where available, assess the retained leads and never infer protest absence from search results.

description: Budapest and university or hospitality disputes dominate discovery. Rural and smaller-town coverage is uneven despite regional and sector searches.
required_followup: Extend local archive checks for smaller towns and counties, including labour, land, housing, healthcare and environmental action.

description: Hungarian and English sources were searched and paraphrased, without independent human Hungarian-language review.
required_followup: Have a Hungarian reader check turnout, demands, police verbs and episode boundaries.

description: Szeged365 returned HTTPS 403 and the Independent returned 405 after web-tool failures; Hirtv remains a tool-error lead.
required_followup: Use legitimate accessible original reports or archive access; respect denials. Verify Szeged365 crowd estimate rather than treating its snippet as body evidence.

description: HPED raw protest data are explicitly repository-staff only, although collection metadata and a codebook are public. No contact or restricted access was attempted.
required_followup: Coordinator may consider a separately authorised legitimate data-access route; notified events still need occurrence and threshold checks.

description: RFE/RL is based on Reuters and AFP; the Independent lead is AP. Telex follow-up repeats its own scene reporting. Outlet counts are not confirmation counts.
required_followup: Preserve agency families and distinguish original correspondent accounts from republications.

description: January 31 physically ended within one hour, but the same organisers gathered again on February 1. Separate physical meetings need not automatically be separate MM episodes.
required_followup: Coordinator should compare the additional Coding Procedure and cross-month evidence before deciding episode boundaries or an owning month for any combined episode.

description: Warnings, identity checks, displacement, fines and proceedings do not settle every response variable; silence remains unknown.
required_followup: Read additional official and eyewitness accounts for arrests, injuries, negotiations or other responses; do not convert fines into arrests.

description: Three organiser fines totalling 1.5 million HUF are attributed to the organiser in the February 1 follow-up, without a verified individual decision.
required_followup: Verify the relevant administrative decisions or contemporaneous official statement, preserving the attribution and temporal scope.

description: The opened Szeged.hu body gives no count; the blocked Szeged365 search card suggests two or three dozen. Fifty actual participants are unverified.
required_followup: Find a legitimate body-accessible contemporaneous count or original video with a defensible contemporaneous count; preserve conflicting estimates.

description: The Szeged university walk has a verified January 30 activity date but no physical withdrawal or end evidence.
required_followup: Follow the group and local reporting before and after January 30 for actual onset and physical closure.

description: The Szeged university walk is linked to university autonomy but its organisation, simultaneous assembly and relationship to other university actions remain uncertain.
required_followup: Review the public invitation and contemporary regional coverage without merging all university campaigns automatically.

description: A January 30 Cserepes market convoy is announced in a tag card. The opened local report establishes trade and a press conference rather than execution of a protest with 50 people.
required_followup: Retrieve the original convoy report and same-day follow-up. Verify actual expressive assembly, simultaneous people and the domestic municipal demand.

description: Earlier market demonstrations are mentioned vaguely; February 1 talks and February 2 protest are proposals. The physical owning month and endpoint remain unknown.
required_followup: Follow earlier January and December reports plus actual February action. An invitation to meet the mayor is not accommodation.

description: The SZFE occupation belongs to September 2020 and physically ended on November 10. January online resistance does not prove a continuous January assembly.
required_followup: Verify earlier owner records and investigate any separately executed January street action if new evidence appears.
